in_marathi.name: Awadhesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Awadhesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Awadhesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ava-dhEShah', which means 'lord of the gods'. In Hindu mythology, Awadhesh is an alternate name for Lord Vishnu, who is one of the principal deities in Hinduism and is often referred to as the preserver of the universe.
